assessment_legend.B: GNU correction with a remaining disclosed mismatch; not approval

byte_encoding: argv/streams retain exact hex plus Python byte repr; filesystem snapshots retain byte names/content. No output normalization or redaction.

execution_contract.terminal: All standard streams are pipes, not terminals. See each case for exact input bytes.
execution_contract.argv0: GNU invoked with utility argv0; base/candidate multicall invoked with coreutils argv0 and utility subcommand.
execution_contract.filesystem: Disposable checker fixtures; recreated for every RM role. RM snapshots are post-execution; () for other utilities means not captured, not an empty directory.
execution_contract.environment_scope: Only parser-relevant controlled test inputs are retained, never a process environment dump.
execution_contract.historical_limit: Original archive did not record inherited TABSIZE/COLORTERM. Fresh controlled inputs are recorded; all original211 outputs reproduced exactly before corrections.

unknown-long-diagnostic-layout.explanation: Native unknown-option diagnostics replace Clap tips/usage; the remaining GNU comparison includes standalone versus multicall-qualified help hints. LS standalone controls match GNU exactly; changed interfaces remain unapproved.

flag-rejects-attached-value-layout.explanation: Both paths reject attached values on flags. Native wording uses the GNU primary error, replacing the old echoed-value/usage layout; multicall help hints remain different.

unknown-short-token-diagnostic-identity.explanation: Native diagnostics name the original complete short-option token, GNU names the offending character, and Clap named its own parsed token. This identity/layout change requires a decision.

ambiguous-long-prefix-diagnostic.explanation: Native resolution identifies ambiguity across supported schema identities. GNU and candidate differ in possibility-list punctuation/order and invocation hints; no diagnostic equivalence or approval is assumed.

empty-long-name-diagnostic-and-aliases.explanation: Splitting an attached value before ambiguity rendering displays -- rather than the original --=x. Supported uutils aliases also change the possibility list. This interface needs an explicit decision.

invalid-choice-diagnostic-layout.explanation: Typed validation rejects invalid choices but emits canonical choice lists and native error wrappers instead of Clap layouts or GNU alias-grouped lists. Status/stdout/files matching GNU are preserved; diagnostic decisions remain.

required-value-consumes-option-looking-t.explanation: Required values now consume an option-looking token, including literal --, as GNU does. Residual diagnostics remain different; successful DIR controls prove inherited lossy raw-byte/grid output rather than a new parser failure.

missing-required-value-exit-status.explanation: LS-family missing-value errors now use GNU usage exit status 2 instead of old Clap status 1. Multicall-qualified hints retain a strict diagnostic difference.

raw-byte-diagnostic-quoting.explanation: Clap replaced invalid UTF-8 bytes. Native quoting preserves identity through shell escapes, while GNU emits raw bytes in the C locale. The new reversible spelling is not automatically GNU-equivalent or approved.

posix-stop-at-first-operand.explanation: POSIXLY_CORRECT presence, including empty, stops scanning at the first operand. Ten baseline-only help pages were checker presentation misclassifications and now classify as exact GNU fixes. Two RM cases correct prompting/deletion choices while retaining inherited remove-file versus remove-regular-file prompt wording.

deferred-time-style-validation.explanation: Non-long DIR correctly ignores an unusable time style; long VDIR validates the consumed value with the existing validator and GNU exit status. Residual VDIR wording and DIR raw-byte/grid rendering are proven inherited.

lost-rm-option-looking-filename-guidance.explanation: Confirmed introduced regression: scanner errors omitted advice for a later existing dash-prefixed filename. Final handling preserves the full original argv and prints both the primary structured error and original advice once. GNU also prints both; residual GNU difference is multicall-qualified invocation.

rm-inherited-hidden-alias-prefix-conflic.explanation: GNU --pres abbreviates preserve-root. The existing uutils presume-input-tty extension collides, so both original base and candidate reject and retain the fixture. Resolving the inherited extension/abbreviation policy requires a decision.
